# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 8 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)

**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** Codex Sinaiticus (ch 1-31) / P.Mich. 130 (ch 32+), Shepherd of Hermas 8 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_008_page_001.jpg

---

## Vision 2, Chapter 4

**1** When she had finished speaking she asked me, "Do you want to know anything more?" I asked her, "Lady, why is the tower built upon water?" "Because," she said, "your life has been saved and will be saved through water. But the tower has been founded on the word of the almighty and glorious Name, and it is upheld by the invisible power of the Lord." **2** I said, "Lady, this is a great and marvelous thing. But who are the six young men who are building it?" "These," she said, "are the holy angels of God who were created first of all, to whom the Lord delivered all his creation — to build it up, increase it, and govern it. Through them the Lord will complete the building." **3** "And all the other people bringing stones — who are they?" "These also are holy angels of God, but the six are over them. The building will be completed and all will rejoice together around the tower and give glory to God, because it is finished." **4** "Lady, I would like to know the fate of the stones." She replied, "The rejected stones not thrown far away — these are those who have sinned and wish to repent. They have not been placed in the building, but they remain close by. If they repent, they can be placed in the building. But if the tower is completed before they repent, they will be cast aside." **5** "The cracked ones are those who have believed hypocritically; they have no genuine integrity. They blow hot and cold, and their works are wicked." **6** "Those thrown far away are the sons of lawlessness. They received the faith, but their wickedness never departed. They are unfit for the building and were thrown far away because of God's wrath, for their evil deeds aroused the Lord to anger." **7** "The rough ones lying around unused are those who knew the truth but did not remain in it and do not associate with the saints; therefore they are useless." **8** "Those with hidden cracks are those who harbor malice against one another in their hearts and cannot truly be at peace; but they appear peaceable on the outside, and when they go apart the malice returns to their hearts. Those are the cracks." **9** "Those thrown into the fire and burned — these have entirely departed from the living God, and repentance has never entered their hearts because of their licentious way of life and the wickednesses they have committed." **10** "Those near the water that could not roll in — these are those who heard the word and desired to be baptized in the name of the Lord; but when the true holiness of the way of truth came to their minds, they changed their decision and turned back to their wicked desires." **11** "That is enough about the tower. Do not ask further — these words are sufficient. But take careful heed of them." She then addressed the virgins: "Be diligent in building the tower, lest the master grows impatient over the delay and turns to another means." With that she left, and with her the young men who had been building, and all the virgins who stood around the tower. I saw nothing left of the tower — only the stones lying on the ground.

---

### Council Notes

The chapter completes the stone typology begun in ch. 7. The climactic question about the tower's water-foundation gets a twofold answer: water = baptism (life is saved through water); the Name = the Word on which the Church is truly built.

The near-baptism stones (v. 10) are spiritually significant: they represent people who were drawn to the faith and even to baptism but pulled back when they understood what it truly required. This is early evidence of the church's awareness of catechetical dropout.

The virgins (v. 11) appear without formal introduction here, foreshadowing their major role in Vision 3. The master's potential "impatience" introduces a note of eschatological urgency — the building must be completed, and the time is short.
